visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man stands in a brightly lit gym, facing a large mirror while holding his smartphone to film. He is positioned in front of a multi-station weight machine. He wears a black sleeveless tank top that emphasizes his broad shoulders and well-defined arms, grey athletic shorts, black sneakers, and a brown baseball cap. He starts by flexing his arms slightly while looking into the mirror to check his pose. (2) The man shifts his focus to his legs. He lifts the hem of his left short leg to reveal his thigh. He flexes his quadriceps intensely, causing the muscle fibers and veins to become prominently visible under the gym's overhead lighting. In the background, a person in a yellow shirt can be seen using a rowing machine. (3) He continues to hold the flex, rotating his leg slightly to display the vastus lateralis and other muscle groups from different angles. The camera maintains a full-shot perspective, capturing his entire physique as he demonstrates his leg strength. The environment is filled with various gym equipment like a red weight bench and metallic frames. (4) The shot ends with a brief camera pan toward the side of the gym, showing more weight machines and the reflection of the large room in the mirrors before the video concludes.
